items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge; Clear the drainage ditch; Return the borrowed rotavator; Renew the public liability insurance; Watering, week of Mon 15 Mar.

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out and send round the AGM minutes.

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes. The main gate lock is waiting on the council’s estates team, and the water meter replacement is waiting on the council; a visit has not yet been booked. The fly-tipping by the gate was reported and is also noted as waiting on the council.

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
Has the number of manure loads been decided? If so, how many?
items.answer: No, the number has not been decided.
